Subject: SDE II offer comp mix & vesting cadence — review and sign-off

Team —

Thanks for taking a quick look at Evan Cho's SDE II package. Context: strong backend candidate (onsite loop 4/10), immediate need on infra team. We propose a standard SDE II structure but wanted alignment on vesting cadence and transient bonus:

Proposed (v1):
- Base: $150,000
- Bonus (target, annual): 12% (performance-based)
- Equity: 45,000 RSUs over 4 years, 1 year cliff then monthly vesting (standard 25/36)
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (one-time)
- Cost center: ENG-INFRA (CC: 4203)

Attached: SDE2_EvanCho_offer_v1.pdf and comp_band_lookup_Q2_2027.xlsx.

Ask: please confirm: (a) comp fits SDE II band, (b) equity not above band ceiling, (c) vesting cadence acceptable (we usually do 4yr w/1yr cliff but candidate asked about front-loaded). If we need to adjust RSU count to hit midpoint vs upper quartile, say so. I need final OK to push to recruiting to extend verbal offer by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SDE II offer comp mix & vesting cadence — review and sign-off

Diego —

Thanks — package looks reasonable and within the SDE II band. A couple of quick notes:

- Equity: 45k RSUs is at the high end of the midpoint for ENG-INFRA for Q2; if we want to stay conservative for headcount burn I'd drop to 40k and keep the signing bonus.
- Vesting: we typically do 4y with 1y cliff, monthly thereafter. If the candidate asks for front-loading, we can offer 25% first-year + accelerated second-year tranche, but that needs explicit approval from Rewards.
- Bonus: 12% target is fine. If this is performance-critical for the next 6 months, consider a 15% target with a short-term milestone bonus (one-time) instead of increasing equity.

Approve the package pending Karthik/Laura confirming budget and any objections.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
